subject.title: Nix: speed up gateway builds and enforce cache-only CI consumers

question: Should maintainers port the remaining source-builder `mv` optimization onto current main, or close this stale branch now that the default npm gateway path and safety checks are already on main?
rationale: The branch no longer cleanly targets the current package layout, and automation should not choose whether the explicit source-override builder still needs this optimization.

options.title: Close as superseded
options.body: Leave current main's npm-shrinkwrap default, symlink checks, and supported-surface CI as the maintained performance path unless new source-override data shows a real need.

options.title: Port the residual move
options.body: Rebase manually and carry only the source-builder move optimization into the current install script with focused source-override package proof.

recommendation.title: Close as superseded
recommendation.body: Leave current main's npm-shrinkwrap default, symlink checks, and supported-surface CI as the maintained performance path unless new source-override data shows a real need.
